The Chipmunk Adventure is a 1987 American animated musical–adventure comedy film based on the Saturday-morning cartoon series Alvin and the Chipmunks and the Alvin and the Chipmunks virtual band and media franchise created by Ross Bagdasarian Sr. The film was directed by Janice Karman and written by Karman and Ross
